api_changes.migration: Default largest_remainder retains numerical parent law; opt-in minimum_change adds checkpointed previous allocation. Ported opt-in for the 2026-10-15 dig.

changed_factors: Add the cell-quota minimum-change objective (aggregate_forward_kl, exponential8 data-cell memory, minimum_change quotas) to the BCAP DualNorm control recipe; optimizer, rates and every other recipe field unchanged; no gradient-signal attenuation.
mechanism_rationale: Stage A of the dig showed the published cell-quota recipe fails ring16 mainly because of its global-NSGDA base. This variant keeps the ring16-passing DualNorm base and adds only the cell objective, to test whether the objective's reported mode_hold/Gaussian-stability benefit survives ring16.
